caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, monochromatic illustration of a standing male figure, likely an indigenous warrior, positioned at the center. The figure is rendered in shades of brown and sepia, with visible highlights and shadows giving a three-dimensional appearance. He wears a feathered headdress, a garment draped across one shoulder and wrapped around the waist, arm and leg bands, and moccasin-style footwear. His right hand rests near his waist while the left arm hangs by his side. Two smaller, similarly dressed figures are drawn in outline style on either side in the background, one to the left of the standing figure and one to the right. These figures also wear feathered headdresses, garments, and what appears to be capes or shields. The composition is centered on the main figure, with the two background figures providing context, all set against a plain, light-colored background. The artist's signature, "J. H. McCallum," is visible near the base of the main figure.
title: Cigar Store Indian
